content.text:
I fixed the site, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass against the approved screenshots.

Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had changed:
- **Text colour:** `--bs-body-color` was `#d6dade`, a pale grey, so the body text and headings looked washed out. I set it back to `#212529`.
- **Heading spacing:** the shared heading rule (`h1`–`h6`) had `margin-bottom: 0.75rem`. I set it back to `0.5rem`. The extra 4px under each of the three headings made the page 12px taller and pushed the content down.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
